title: PTA will be abolished in a few months: President
summary: The Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA) will be abolished in a few months, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake told Parliament today.

title: Iran warns ships it’s ‘unacceptable and dangerous’ to transit the Strait of Hormuz without their approval
summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned shipowners on Wednesday that any new transit route through the Strait of Hormuz established without coordination with Tehran is “unacceptable and dangerous,” threatening actions against vessels that ignore its instructions.

title: More disclosures on today’s arrests to follow: President
summary: More disclosures regarding those arrested today will be made during the course of the day, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake told Parliament.

title: Government does not accept that an individual can survive with Rs. 17,700 per month: Minister
summary: The government won’t accept that an individual can survive with Rs. 17,700 per month as claimed by the Department of Census and Statistics, Deputy Minister Anil Jayantha told Parliament today.

title: Global Ebola risk ’remains low’: WHO Chief
summary: The global risk ’’remains low’’ from a deadly Ebola outbreak centred in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the World Health Organization chief said Wednesday, after a case was confirmed in France. France on Wednesday announced its first confirmed case of Ebola identified on its territory: a doctor who had flown back from the DR Congo, which is fighting a major outbreak.

title: Private bus operators seek fare hike from July 1
summary: Private bus operators have formally requested the National Transport Commission (NTC) to implement the annual bus fare revision from July 1, ahead of the previously proposed date of July 5.

title: No decision on change of fuel prices: Minister
summary: No decision has been taken on the change of fuel prices yet, Minister of Power and Energy Anura Karunatilaka told Parliament today.

title: At least 32 dead, 700 injured after massive earthquakes slam Venezuela
summary: Two powerful earthquakes struck Venezuela on June 24, collapsing buildings in the capital of Caracas and killing dozens of people and injuring hundreds of others, officials said.

title: Colombia’s leftwing candidate concedes election to Trump-endorsed millionaire
summary: The defeated leftwing candidate in Colombia’s presidential runoff has conceded to the far-right, Trump-admiring millionaire lawyer Abelardo de la Espriella.

title: Scandal behind claiming Ditwah disaster relief: Deputy Minister
summary: There is a scandal behind claiming Ditwah relief where some house owners in places such as Opanayake who have been relocated due to landslide threats had come and settled in vulnerable areas before cyclone Ditwah hit the area, Deputy Minister Aruna Jayasekera told Parliament today.

title: Rohitha Rajapaksa appears before Central Crime Investigation Bureau
summary: Rohitha Rajapaksa, the son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, appeared before the Colombo Central Crime Investigation Bureau (CCIB) today to record a statement in connection with an ongoing investigation.

title: Bus driver dies after sudden medical emergency causes bus crash in Wellampitiya
summary: An SLTB bus driver died after suffering a sudden medical emergency while transporting nearly 50 passengers from Colombo to Ampara, causing the bus to veer out of control and crash into several roadside structures in Wellampitiya early yesterday morning.

title: NPPers receives ‘Santhosham’ from leading businessman following allowing solar project: MP
summary: A group of NPP politicians have received a santhosham from a leading businessman for allowing a solar power project on a land in the reserved forest area in Polonnaruwa, opposition MP Chamara Sampath Dassanayake alleged in Parliament yesterday.

title: Tragic end for wild jumbo after rescue attempt fails in Thanamalwila
summary: A 25-year-old wild elephant died during a rescue operation after falling into a narrow well in the Kudaoya area of Samagipura, Thanamalwila, despite desperate efforts by wildlife officials and local residents to save the animal.

title: Inland Revenue Amendment Act: Key changes explained
summary: The Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act No. 11 of 2026, which was certified on June 3, 2026, has introduced several significant changes to Sri Lanka’s tax framework. Here are some of the key amendments.
